Definition: Kedesh, the name of four places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Kedesh = "holy place"; 1) a city in the extreme south of Judah; 1a) same as 'Kadesh' and 'Kadesh-barnea'; 2) a city of Issachar allotted to the Gershonite Levites; 3) a fortified Canaanite city allotted to Naphtali; 4) a city of refuge in Naphtali
